places.name: Citadel of Namur (Fortress & Viewpoint)
places.ai_summary: The Citadel of Namur is a historic fortress offering panoramic views of the city and the Meuse River. Visitors can explore its tunnels, museums, and enjoy the scenic cable car ride.

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary during winter months.

places.place_tip: Take the cable car for a unique perspective of the fortress.

places.name: Old Town Namur
places.ai_summary: Old Town Namur is a charming area filled with cobblestone streets, historic buildings, and quaint shops. It is the perfect place to explore the city’s rich history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Best explored during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the local cafes and boutiques for a unique experience.

places.name: St. Aubin’s Cathedral
places.ai_summary: St. Aubin’s Cathedral is a stunning example of Gothic architecture, known for its intricate stained glass windows and impressive organ. It’s a peaceful place to admire art and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Check for mass times and special events.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the chance to hear the organ concert if available.
places.address: Place de l'Ancienne Barrière, 5000 Namur, Belgium

places.name: Namur Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The Namur Archaeological Museum showcases artifacts from the region’s rich history, including Roman and medieval times. It’s a great place to learn about the area’s past.

opening_hours.notes: Free admission on the first Sunday of the month.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Parlement de Wallonie
places.ai_summary: The Parlement de Wallonie is the regional parliament of Wallonia, located in a beautiful historic building. Guided tours are available to learn about the political history and functions.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking required for guided tours.

places.place_tip: Visit the hemicycle (chamber) where the parliament meets.
places.address: Rue de la Loi 1, 5000 Namur, Belgium

places.name: Musée Félicien Rops
places.ai_summary: This museum is dedicated to the works of Félicien Rops, a Belgian artist known for his provocative and imaginative art. The museum is located in the artist’s former home.

opening_hours.notes: Check for temporary exhibitions.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for detailed insights into the artworks.

places.name: Meuse River Cruise
places.ai_summary: A cruise on the Meuse River offers a relaxing way to see the sights of Namur from the water. Various cruise options are available, including dinner cruises.

opening_hours.notes: Advance booking recommended, especially for dinner cruises.

places.place_tip: Bring a camera to capture the beautiful riverside views.

places.name: Namur Train Station District
places.ai_summary: The area around Namur Train Station is bustling with activity, featuring shops, cafes, and easy access to public transport. It’s a convenient base for exploring the city and beyond.

opening_hours.notes: Safe and busy area with lots of amenities.

places.place_tip: Great place to grab a quick bite or do some shopping.

places.name: Eglise Saint-Loup (Baroque Interior)
places.ai_summary: Eglise Saint-Loup is a stunning Baroque church known for its elaborate interior and beautiful altar. It’s a hidden gem in Namur’s religious architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during weekdays.

places.place_tip: Look out for the detailed sculptures and paintings.

places.name: Pont de Jambes Bridge
places.ai_summary: The Pont de Jambes is a historic bridge offering picturesque views of the Meuse River and the city. It’s a great spot for photos and leisurely walks.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during daylight hours.

places.place_tip: Visit at sunset for a stunning view.

places.name: Parc Louise-Marie
places.ai_summary: Parc Louise-Marie is a beautiful park in the city center, perfect for a relaxing stroll or a picnic. The park features lovely gardens, fountains, and statues.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 21:00, park opens at 07:00.

places.place_tip: Bring a book and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere.

places.ai_summary: The Terra Nova Visitor Centre offers interactive exhibits and information about the Meuse River and its ecosystem. It’s an educational stop for visitors of all ages.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special events and workshops.

places.place_tip: Participate in a workshop for a hands-on experience.

places.name: Place d’Armes Square
places.ai_summary: Place d’Armes is a historic square in the heart of Namur, surrounded by impressive buildings and lively cafes. It’s a great place to relax and people-watch.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed at a leisurely pace.

places.place_tip: Try the local pastries at a nearby cafe.

places.name: Namur Bell Tower (UNESCO)
places.ai_summary: The Namur Bell Tower is a UNESCO-listed belfry, known for its distinctive architecture and historical significance. Visitors can climb the tower for a panoramic view of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last admission one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning to avoid crowds.

places.name: Namur Cable Car
places.ai_summary: The Namur Cable Car provides a scenic and leisurely way to reach the Citadel from the city. The ride offers beautiful views of the Meuse River and the surrounding area.

opening_hours.notes: Weather permitting, check for updates.

places.place_tip: Combine with a visit to the Citadel for a full experience.
places.address: Avenue de la Citadelle, 5000 Namur, Belgium

places.ai_summary: The Citadel Tunnels Tour offers an intriguing glimpse into the underground passages of the Citadel of Namur. The guided tour explains the history and function of these tunnels.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring a flashlight.

places.place_tip: Combine with the Citadel visit for a complete experience.

places.ai_summary: Parc Attractif Reine Fabiola is a family-friendly park featuring playgrounds, picnic areas, and walking paths. It’s a great place for a leisurely day outdoors.

opening_hours.notes: Gates close at 21:00, park opens at 07:00.

places.place_tip: Pack a picnic and enjoy a day in the park.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for more historical buildings.

places.place_tip: Look out for temporary art exhibitions.

opening_hours.notes: Best enjoyed at a leisurely pace.

places.place_tip: Visit early morning or late afternoon for the best light.
